summary: @waltmossberg Thank you! We need more in the media like you to speak up. Sad my social justice and #literacies allies haven't come out hard against Facebook. Not only did Facebook enable hate they weaponized it themselves to influence Congress.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@waltmossberg Thank you! We need more in the media like you to speak up. Sad my social justice and #literacies allies haven't come out hard against Facebook.

Not only did Facebook enable hate they weaponized it themselves to influence Congress.
